title: Amazon Christmas Decor
headline: Amazon Christmas Decor That Looks Designer (Burgundy, Gold and Zero Regrets)
seo_title: Amazon Christmas Decor That Looks Designer: 8 Finds | Looks Like Luxe
description: Amazon Christmas decor that looks designer: a pre-lit tree, nutcrackers, gold mercury ornaments, velvet bows and more. Eight festive finds with great reviews.
intro: Every December, a certain kind of home appears on Pinterest. Velvet bows. Gold everything. A tree that looks like it was decorated by someone with a trust fund and a strong opinion.
Reader, you can do this. On Amazon. With a normal budget.

I went through the search results with a glass of something festive and built a list of eight Christmas decor finds that look designer: a full pre-lit tree, nutcrackers with presence, gold mercury glass and the velvet bows you keep seeing everywhere. Every one has real reviews and a rating of 4.5 stars or higher at the time I checked.
Some are statement pieces, two are small cheap extras, and none of them are a plastic reindeer wearing a scarf. Let's decorate, darling.
disclosure: As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases, which means if you tap a link and buy, I may earn a small commission at no extra cost to you. Prices and availability live on Amazon.

products.name: YITAHOME Pre-Lit 7.5ft Artificial Christmas Tree with Remote
products.best_for: The woman who wants the magazine-cover tree without the magazine-cover price
copy: A full 7.5-foot pre-lit tree with a remote, so the lights are handled and you can spend your energy on the part that matters: the bows. It's the anchor of the whole look.
It has a 4.6-star rating, and it's a big-ticket piece that still comes in at a fraction of what designer trees cost.
Verdict: build the room around this one.

products.name: Kurt Adler 16-Inch Wooden Gingerbread Nutcracker
products.best_for: The mantel that needs one very dramatic guard
copy: A classic wooden nutcracker in warm gingerbread tones, the kind that makes a mantel look styled on purpose.
It has a 4.7-star rating from more than 2,000 reviewers. Kurt Adler is the name designers have been quietly using for years.
Verdict: instant old-money Christmas, no explanation required.

products.name: Kurt Adler 13.5-Inch Hollywood Candy Soldier Nutcracker
products.best_for: The shelf that wants a little sweetness and a lot of drama
copy: A candy-striped soldier nutcracker that adds a pop of color without turning the room into a cartoon.
It has a 4.7-star rating from nearly 500 reviewers, and it pairs beautifully with the gingerbread one.
Verdict: a tiny soldier with a very large personality.

products.name: Lighted Ceramic Christmas Village Houses, 5-Piece Set
products.best_for: The sideboard that deserves a glowing little town
copy: A set of lighted ceramic houses that turns a console table or mantel into a cozy winter village at night.
It has a 4.8-star rating from more than 140 reviewers, and the soft glow does half the styling for you.
Verdict: the "where did you get that?" piece in a room full of candles.

products.name: DN DECONATION Gold Mercury Glass Ball Ornaments, Set of 12
products.best_for: The tree that needs to shimmer like it costs more
copy: Twelve gold mercury glass balls with that antique, softly aged shine you see on designer trees.
They have a 4.5-star rating from more than 180 reviewers, and a set of twelve goes a long way on a big tree.
Verdict: shimmer without the splurge.

products.name: Homemory 6-Piece Flameless Taper Candles with Remote
products.best_for: The table that wants candlelight and zero fire risk
copy: Six ivory flameless tapers with a remote, timer and dimmer. They look like real candles in a holder, minus the drips and the worry.
They have a 4.5-star rating from more than 3,200 reviewers, and they're a small, practical piece that makes a tablescape look expensive.
Verdict: the cheapest way to look like you hired a stylist.

products.name: Burgundy Velvet Ribbon Bows for Christmas Tree, 12-Piece Set
products.best_for: The tree that is absolutely going to be wearing bows
copy: Twelve oversized burgundy velvet bows, the single most-saved Christmas trend on Pinterest right now. Tuck them in the branches and the whole tree looks designed.
They have a 4.7-star rating from more than 1,100 reviewers, and they're an easy, affordable add-on.
Verdict: bows are the new tinsel.

products.name: Gold Cast Iron Reindeer Figurines, Set of 2
products.best_for: The mantel that needs a little brass in the lineup
copy: A pair of gold reindeer figurines that add that metallic glint the high-end decor pages love.
They have a 4.5-star rating, and they sit beautifully next to candles and greenery.
Verdict: the finishing touch that makes it look collected.

interludes.3: A designer room is mostly repetition: the same color three times, in three different textures.
interludes.6: Pick two colors and commit. Burgundy and gold will never let you down.

outro: And that's the list: eight Christmas decor finds that look far more expensive than they are.
If you take one thing from this guide, let it be this. Choose two colors, add the bows and warm lighting, and the room will do the rest.
Until the next holiday emergency, darling.
